positive.prompt: Prepare this repository for agent work with real instructions, verification commands, and lint gates.
Interview me about tooling, then set up AGENTS.md, the build runner, formatting, and version control.
Bootstrap this new project so automated contributors know its purpose and exact test command.

negative.prompt: Build a new product capability after clarifying its user flow and scope boundaries.
Standardize the existing README, ADRs, and changelog and run the documentation gate.

evals.prompt: Set up an empty repository. The human has not chosen a build system or version-control model.
evals.expected_output: A survey-backed interview with recommendations, not invented configuration.
expectations: The workflow asks the human to choose material tooling such as the build runner and whether to adopt Jujutsu.
No verification command or tool choice is fabricated merely to fill documentation.
